questions.text: Define speed and write its SI unit.
questions.answer_key: Speed is the distance covered by a body in unit time. SI unit: metre per second (m/s).

questions.text: A car covers 150 m in 12 s. Find its speed.
questions.answer_key: v = s / t = 150 m / 12 s = 12.5 m/s (formula 1, substitution 2, answer with unit 2).

questions.text: State Newton's first law of motion.
questions.answer_key: A body remains at rest or continues to move with uniform velocity in a straight line unless an unbalanced external force acts on it.
